notes: Zero-shot gold T4 adjudicated (PLAN 2.4): blind markers A and B plus FRESH third marking; 13 lines; adjudication record in gold/T4/gb_efbb1e/adjudication.json.

bends.note: web 1 -> side-A wall tab 1 (patch 4); tab is a separate plate: wall cut full height by ~1-2 mm slits (adjudicator gap map, all height bands 1-14 mm); extent = tab length between slits; web side = local web-half plane (seed 6 mm in from the fold on the patch-1 skin, r5, no grow) because the web is two halves ~7 deg apart / bowed (patch 1 rms 0.30)

adjudication.reason: Both blind markers merged each side wall into 1 line (A: "short bridges between windows"; B: "5 coplanar segments split by reliefs"). The FRESH third marking has 5 lines per side. Adjudicator gap map on the raw mesh (B line frame, 0.5 mm stations, wall-height bands 1-4, 4-7, 7-10, 10-14 mm): each wall is cut through its full height by ~1-2 mm slits at t ~ -48, -22, 45, 72 on both sides, so each wall is 5 separate tabs (~84/24/65/25/63 mm) joined only to the web; the tab planes also differ by up to ~1.2 deg. Disconnected collinear tabs are separate plates, so 1 line each (GOLD_SET_V2 canary-confirmed ruling in T1, and the same ruling on the twin scan of this part family in T5 gb_0f8d41). Markers wrong, FRESH right. Lines rebuilt by the adjudicator (web side = local web-half plane, tab patch, extent between slits, station_median apex).
